title: La lavadora
text:
Señora Gómez:

La lavadora del apartamento no funciona desde el lunes. ¿Podría enviar a alguien esta semana?

Gracias,
Lucía
translation:
Mrs Gómez:

The flat's washing machine hasn't worked since Monday. Could you send someone this week?

Thank you,
Lucía

options: To report a broken washing machine

questions.q: Since when has it not worked?
What does Lucía hope will happen?
questions.explain: She asks Mrs Gómez to send someone 'esta semana'.
